name: a second import of overlapping notes updates what the first built and adds only the new (M205: the import may update nodes it built, no twins)

then.text:
Supplier notes, week one

Flour: Hartmann mill, organic T65, 0.92 per kilo at 200 kg a month; deliveries Tuesday.

Butter: Val d'Or 84% fat, 6.10 per kilo.

Coffee: Northwind roasters, house blend at 18 per kilo.

Supplier notes, week two

Flour: Hartmann confirmed 0.92 per kilo; deliveries move to Wednesday.

Butter: Val d'Or 84% fat, 6.10 per kilo — unchanged.

Coffee: Northwind will lend a grinder if we take 15 kilos a month.

New: eggs from Copse Farm, 2.40 a dozen, delivered with the flour.
